names.note: Read out of the body of saint.gr's page for the pair, «του Αγίου Γκέρεμπραν (Gerebernus ή Gerebran)», with the rank word left off; the day's own line prints his name in Latin letters, «Άγιοι Dymphna και Gerebernus».

death.note: saint.gr says the king «τους σκότωσε και τους δυο» — killed them both — and dates that killing «Ήταν 15 Μαΐου, κάπου μεταξύ 620 & 640 μ.Χ.» The bounds are the two years the page prints; it gives him no year of birth and no age.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Dymphna και Gerebernus»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, whose one line names two saints and whose page carries two head names, «Αγια Dymphna» and «Αγιος Gerebernus» — an enumerated pair, and so one folder each. **Everything the page says of him it says in passing**: he was Dymphna's spiritual father, he helped her flee, the king pursued them both and killed them both. **`types` carries only `martyr`**: «πνευματικός», spiritual father, is how the page names his part, and although that office is ordinarily a priest's the page does not call him a presbyter, so nothing is added on the strength of the word. **No hymn, no relics, no country of his own, no year of birth, no age.** The page gives no separate account of him at all and the whole of his life here is what it says of him inside hers.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
